name: RegularizeDeviceReference
pure_preflight: LLD-12 deliberate proof acquisition after governed hold; acquisition is non-authoritative and does not validate or consume the proof
transaction_boundary: one outer UnitOfWork; optional CreateNetworkElement reducer is receipt-free; proof validation/consumption occurs inside this same UnitOfWork
authoritative_reads: current deliberate-action target/base revision/scope fingerprint bindings
guards: inside the UnitOfWork LLD-12 validate_and_consume returns ValidatedDeliberateActionV1 for the exact governed promotion action
receipt_order: replay -> revalidate exact target/base revision/fingerprint -> validate_and_consume proof -> single outer receipt -> optional NE reducer -> resolution event/current -> audit -> commit
mutations: LLD-12 deliberate-proof single-use consumption record/state inside caller UnitOfWork
revision_effects: resolution revision increments once; operational Device Reference revision/relationships unchanged
